name: Tokomon
text: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted by dropping to 0 DP, this Digimon gets +1000 DP for the turn.

name: Patamon
text: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted by dropping to 0 DP, gain 1 memory.

name: Angemon
text: [When Attacking] If you have 4 or more security cards, gain 1 memory.

name: Unimon
text: ＜Blocker＞ (When an opponent's Digimon attacks, you may suspend this Digimon to force the opponent to attack it instead.)[When Attacking] Lose 2 memory.

name: MagnaAngemon
text: [When Attacking] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -1000 DP for the turn.

name: Angewomon
text: [When Digivolving] When you have 3 security cards or less, trigger ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞. (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)

name: Seraphimon
text: [When Attacking] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP for the turn.

name: T.K. Takaishi
text: [Opponent's Turn] All of your Security Digimon get +2000 DP.
[Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.

name: Heaven's Gate
text: [Main] 1 of your Digimon gets +3000 DP for the turn.
[Security] All of your Digimon and Security Digimon get +5000 DP for the turn. Then add this card to its owner's hand.

name: Heaven's Charm
text: [Main] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
[Security] Add this card to its owner's hand.

name: Holy Flame
text: [Main] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains ＜Security Attack -3＞ (This Digimon checks 3 fewer security cards) until the end of your opponent's next turn.
[Security] All of your opponent's Digimon gain ＜Security Attack -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 fewer security card) for the turn.

name: Seven Heavens
text: [Main] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -10000 DP for the turn.
